jobs.description:
About the role:

At Quantum Systems, we are building highly autonomous interceptor systems that must perceive, decide, and act under extreme latency, motion, and environmental constraints.

We are looking for a Computer Vision & AI Engineer to drive the perception stack of our Counter-UAS interceptor platform. You will work on low-latency camera pipelines, small-object detection, object tracking, sensor fusion, visual odometry, precision landing, camera calibration, embedded inference, and data pipelines for training and validation.

This role is suited for someone with a strong academic or practical background in computer vision, AI, robotics, or perception systems. A Master’s degree is expected; a PhD is a strong plus. We are open to ambitious early-career candidates if they bring strong technical depth, practical implementation skills, and the ability to own complex perception problems.

Your Mission

You will develop the vision and AI pipeline that turns raw camera data into actionable perception outputs for autonomous flight. This includes low-latency detection and tracking, motion-aware vision, sensor fusion with inertial data, 3D direction-vector estimation, GPS-denied navigation, and precision landing support.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Bring up, optimize, and maintain high-performance camera pipelines, including CSI camera interfaces, raw image access, buffering, synchronization, and latency reduction.

  • Develop detection algorithms for small and difficult-to-see objects in moving and rotating camera images.

  • Combine machine learning and classical computer vision approaches where appropriate.

  • Fuse inertial data, motion information, and visual data to improve detection and tracking in moving image sequences.

  • Build object tracking pipelines that can switch from initial detection to low-latency tracking once a target has been acquired.

  • Optimize perception pipelines for embedded execution on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

  • Work toward high frame-rate processing targets in the range of 100–300 FPS, where technically feasible.

  • Use camera intrinsics and extrinsics to transform image-space detections into 3D direction vectors or other navigation-relevant outputs.

  • Work on GPS-denied navigation concepts using visual odometry, including approaches with forward-facing camera views rather than only downward-looking cameras.

  • Develop visual support for precision landing, including height estimation, velocity estimation, and motion-state estimation from limited camera perspectives.

  • Build and maintain the data pipeline from onboard recordings to cloud storage, preprocessing, annotation, dataset generation, training, validation, and benchmarking.

  • Work with annotation tools such as SuperAnnotate, CVAT, Label Studio, or comparable systems.

  • Benchmark and evaluate different model and algorithm families, including approaches such as CenterNet, SuperPoint, SuperGlue, optical flow, feature tracking, object detection, and lightweight embedded models.

  • Build deployment pipelines using ONNX, TensorRT, custom inference runners, or comparable embedded inference tooling.

  • Collaborate closely with autonomy, flight control, embedded software, test, and systems engineering teams.



What you bring to the team:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in computer vision, AI, robotics, machine learning, electrical engineering, computer science, aerospace engineering, or a comparable technical field.

  • Strong understanding of computer vision fundamentals, camera geometry, feature detection, object detection, tracking, calibration, and image-space to 3D transformations.

  • Practical experience implementing computer vision or machine learning pipelines in Python and C++.

  • Experience with embedded inference, ideally on NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, GStreamer, V4L2, or similar technologies.

  • Ability to read, understand, and implement ideas from current research papers.

  • Understanding of latency, throughput, profiling, memory movement, and real-time constraints.

  • Experience with dataset creation, annotation workflows, training/validation splits, metrics, and benchmarking.

  • Strong mathematical intuition and willingness to debug both algorithms and real-world sensor data.

  • Ability to take ownership of a technical area and drive it from research prototype to flight-test-ready software.

    • Experience with UAV perception, robotics perception, visual odometry, SLAM, sensor fusion, or tracking systems.

    • Experience with IMU-camera fusion, ego-motion compensation, rolling-shutter effects, or high-frame-rate cameras.

    • Experience with precision landing, visual navigation, or GPS-denied navigation.

    • Experience building cloud-based ML training and validation pipelines.

jobs.description:
Auf einen Blick

Arbeitsort: deutschlandweit oder in einem unserer Büros in München und Berlin
Arbeitsmodell: Remote deutschlandweit und zusätzlich bis zu drei Monate pro Jahr innerhalb Europas.

Warum gibt es diese Stelle?

PIABO entwickelt eine eigene Softwareplattform, die internes Wissen und Abläufe für die Teams nutzbar macht. Erste Anwendungen sind bereits im Einsatz. Unser Anspruch ist, daraus ein verlässliches Produktportfolio zu entwickeln: Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag genutzt werden, einen nachvollziehbaren Nutzen stiften und sich bei belegter Wirkung für weitere Teams, Kundenprojekte oder neue Angebote eignen.

Damit diese Entwicklung gelingt, braucht es klare Entscheidungen darüber, welche Probleme Priorität haben und welche Lösungen verlässlich in den Einsatz kommen. Die Rolle verbindet Produkt- und Technologieentwicklung, gibt dem bestehenden fünfköpfigen Team aus Development und Project Management eine gemeinsame Richtung und verantwortet zugleich PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft.


Drei Must-haves für die Stelle

  • Produkt- und Business-Urteil: Du verbindest Produktentscheidungen mit konkretem Geschäftsnutzen.
  • Hands-on Engineering: Du bringst eigene Entwicklungserfahrung mit und beurteilst technische Qualität praktisch.
  • Führung und operative Verantwortung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Führung und einen verlässlichen IT-Betrieb.


Was du bei uns tust und wie

  • Portfolio und Priorisierung: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen. Du bewertest Vorhaben nach Geschäftswirkung, Machbarkeit, Risiken und Kapazität und übersetzt priorisierte Themen in realistische Umsetzungsetappen. Wenn Nutzen oder Voraussetzungen nicht tragen, machst du das transparent und empfiehlst Alternativen.
  • Use Cases und Erfolgskriterien: Gemeinsam mit den nutzenden Teams nimmst du konkrete Abläufe und Probleme auf, grenzt den Bedarf ein und legst fest, welchen Nutzen die Lösung schaffen soll und woran erfolgreiche Nutzung erkennbar wird.
  • Software entwickeln: Du baust selbst Prototypen und produktive Software mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen, darunter Coding Agents und LLM-APIs. Du testest Annahmen früh und führst tragfähige Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz.
  • Technische Qualität sichern: Du verantwortest technische Konzepte und Qualitätsmaßstäbe: von Architektur, APIs, Datenflüssen und Integrationen bis zu Tests, Code-Reviews, Dokumentation und Übergabe in den Betrieb.
  • Team führen und entwickeln: Du führst das fünfköpfige Team aus Development und Project Management disziplinarisch. Du setzt gemeinsame Prioritäten und Qualitätsmaßstäbe, gibst Feedback und entwickelst Zusammenarbeit und fachliche Stärke weiter.
  • Einführung und Wirkung nachhalten: Du begleitest die Einführung in den nutzenden Teams und prüfst anhand der vereinbarten Erfolgssignale und Rückmeldungen, ob die Lösung im Alltag genutzt wird und den erwarteten Nutzen liefert. Daraus leitest du ab, was weiterentwickelt, skaliert oder beendet wird.
  • Operative IT verantworten: Du verantwortest PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft und koordinierst die zuständigen internen und externen Spezialist:innen. Du hältst Zuständigkeiten für verlässlichen Betrieb, Zugriffe, Security und Datenschutz klar und sorgst dafür, dass Fragen mit der nötigen Expertise bearbeitet werden.


Das bringst du mit

Die folgenden Erfahrungen sind für die Rolle erforderlich; unterschiedliche Karrierewege können passen:

  • Du bringst mindestens zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Software- und Produktentwicklung sowie mehrere Jahre eigene Entwicklungspraxis mit – zum Beispiel mit Node.js/TypeScript, Python oder Go. Du hast produktive Systeme selbst gebaut und betrieben.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding Agents und LLM-APIs (Agentic Engineering) und kannst ihre Leistungsfähigkeit und Grenzen einschätzen.
  • Du hast mindestens ein digitales Produkt von der Idee bis in den Betrieb verantwortet. An einem konkreten Beispiel kannst du zeigen, wie du bei offenen Anforderungen Vision, Roadmap und Prioritäten festgelegt, die Lösung in produktive Nutzung gebracht und anhand messbarer Ergebnisse die nächsten Schritte gesteuert hast.
  • Du hast ein Team disziplinarisch geführt und Mitarbeitende fachlich weiterentwickelt. Du arbeitest mit Geschäftsführung, Projektmanagement und Development auf Augenhöhe und challengst Anforderungen, wenn sie nicht zum Ziel beitragen.
  • Du hast den IT-Betrieb selbst verantwortet oder eng gesteuert – einschließlich Security, Zugriffsmanagement und Datenschutz.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1) und sehr gut Englisch (B2).


Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Du hast als CTO oder CPO in einem Startup gearbeitet oder ein technisches Unternehmen mit aufgebaut.
  • Du hast AI-Produkte oder -Plattformen über mehrere Geschäftsbereiche hinweg in die Nutzung gebracht oder skaliert.
  • Du hast SaaS-Produkte oder wiederverwendbare Software für Kundenprojekte verantwortet.


What’s in it for you?

Du steigst in ein bestehendes AI-Produktsetup ein: Erste Anwendungen sind im Einsatz und ein fünfköpfiges Team ist vorhanden. So kannst du die nächste Entwicklungsstufe mitgestalten, statt bei null anzufangen.

jobs.title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
jobs.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products
  • Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail


How You’ll Grow

As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. You'll work closely enough with customers and engineers to see the direct consequences of your decisions, and as the product and team grow, you'll have the option to shape whether and how a design function scales beyond you.


What You Get

  • Real ownership: your designs define how industrial customers experience the product
  • Direct impact on a product that helps companies cut energy waste and costs
  • A small, senior-leaning team with short decision paths and close access to customers
  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Hybrid setup based in our Munich office, with regular in-person days alongside the team


The Application

Send us your CV and portfolio — we don't do long forms or generic cover letters. Surprise us.

About Doctorflix

Medizin entwickelt sich schneller als je zuvor, und Ärzte müssen ihr ganzes Berufsleben lang mithalten. Doctorflix ist die digitale Plattform, auf der Ärzte im deutschsprachigen Raum lernen: kostenlos, zertifiziert und mit dem größten Angebot im Markt. Weil wir dort sind, wo Ärzte ihr Wissen auf den neuesten Stand bringen, sind wir auch der Kanal, über den Pharma- und MedTech-Unternehmen sie relevant erreichen. Unsere Vision: die führende Plattform für medizinisches Wissen zu werden, zuerst in DACH, dann international. Ein Ort, an dem Ärzte lernen, sich austauschen und bessere Entscheidungen für ihre Patienten treffen. Wir sind ein VC-finanziertes Startup aus Berlin und wachsen organisch wie anorganisch.


Role

Wir sind aus der frühen Startup-Phase herausgewachsen: ein neues Sales-Team, neue Produkte, anorganisches Wachstum in Vorbereitung, der Schritt ins Ausland in Sicht. Was uns jetzt bremst, sind nicht fehlende Ideen, sondern Prozesse, die nicht mitwachsen.

Als Chief of Staff arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Gründern Hans und Leo und machst aus Strategie ein laufendes System. Du baust unsere Operations so um, dass sie bei doppelter Größe noch funktionieren, automatisierst, was kein Mensch mehr tun sollte, und übernimmst die Projekte, die über unser nächstes Jahr entscheiden.

Das ist weder eine Assistenzrolle noch ein reiner Strategie-Job. Du schreibst nicht die Folie über den Prozess. Du baust den Prozess und, wo es Sinn ergibt, den Agenten, der ihn ausführt.


Your tasks

Operations & Organisation für Scale

  • Du nimmst unsere Kernprozesse auseinander (Angebot bis Rechnung, Kampagnen-Go-live, Content-Produktion, Reporting) und baust sie neu: klare Ownership, saubere Übergaben, messbare Durchlaufzeiten.
  • Du etablierst unseren Operating Rhythm: OKR-Prozess mit Owner pro Key Result, Leadership-Meetings, KPI-Reviews, nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen.
  • Du professionalisierst die Organisation: Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, ein Tool-Stack, der zusammenspielt (ClickUp, Notion, Metabase, CRM), und genau die Regeln, die wir brauchen. Nicht mehr.
  • Gemeinsam mit Finance und externen Partnern machst du Backoffice-Prozesse wie Rechnungsstellung, Forderungsmanagement und Abschluss-Zulieferung robust.

Automatisierung & AI-Workflows

  • Du verantwortest unsere AI-native-Agenda: In jedem Team identifizierst du die Workflows mit dem größten Hebel, automatisierst sie und misst die Wirkung (Zeit, Fehlerquote, Durchlaufzeit).
  • Du baust selbst: Agenten und Automationen mit LLM-APIs (z. B. Claude), n8n, Make oder Zapier, Skripten und Schnittstellen zwischen unseren Systemen. Bei größeren Vorhaben steuerst du Product und Engineering.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass jede Automation dokumentiert ist, überwacht wird und einen Owner hat, statt nach drei Monaten still kaputtzugehen.

Strategische Sonderprojekte

  • M&A & Post-Merger-Integration: Du begleitest Zukäufe von der Due Diligence bis zur Integration. Teams, Kunden, Plattformen, Inhalte und Prozesse führst du mit einem 100-Tage-Plan und klaren Synergiezielen zusammen.
  • Internationalisierung: Du bereitest den Markteintritt außerhalb von DACH vor: Business Case, Markt- und Partneranalyse, operatives Playbook.
  • Themen, die heute niemand im Team ownt, die aber jemand ownen muss.

Führung

  • Du führst Teams und Projektgruppen bereichsübergreifend, je nach Phase auch interimistisch, etwa ein integriertes Team nach einem Zukauf.
  • Du forderst Teamleads heraus, ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen, und hältst nach, dass sie erreicht werden.

Fundraising & Investor Relations

  • Du unterstützt die Gründer bei Finanzierungsrunden: Equity Story, Finanzmodell, Datenraum, Due-Diligence-Fragen.
  • Du verantwortest Board-Unterlagen und das monatliche Investoren-Reporting inhaltlich mit.


Your profile

  • Operator: Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mehrere Jahre in operativer Verantwortung, z. B. in Operations, BizOps oder Founder's Office eines Scale-ups, als Gründer oder nach einem Start in Beratung, PE oder VC mit Wechsel ins Operative. Du hast Operations nachweislich auf- oder umgebaut, nicht nur analysiert.
  • Automator: Du kannst konkrete Prozesse zeigen, die du automatisiert hast, mit Vorher und Nachher. Du arbeitest sicher mit Low-Code-Tools und APIs. SQL oder Python sind ein Plus.
  • AI-native: Du nutzt AI nicht als besseres Google. Du hast Workflows gebaut, in denen LLMs echte Arbeit übernehmen (Agenten, Integrationen, Kontext- und Prompt-Design, Qualitätskontrolle), und weißt, wo sie scheitern.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch fließend.


Why us?

jobs.title: Junior Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Davon träumen wir:

Mehr als Recruiting. Die richtigen Menschen für die richtigen Aufgaben.
 
VielfaltMenü befindet sich in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung. Wir schärfen unsere Organisation, professionalisieren unsere Prozesse und richten uns noch konsequenter auf unsere Kund:innen, unsere Mitarbeiter:innen und nachhaltiges Wachstum aus.
Dazu gehört auch ein neues Verständnis von Recruiting.
Wir wollen Stellen nicht einfach besetzen. Wir wollen verstehen, welche Kompetenzen wir wirklich benötigen, wie wir sie erkennen und welche Menschen zu unserer Organisation und unseren Zielen passen.

Dafür suchen wir dich als Junior Talent Acquisition Partner:in

Du musst nicht bereits zehn Jahre Recruiting-Erfahrung mitbringen. 
Entscheidend sind für uns analytisches Denken, Neugier, ein ausgeprägter Qualitätsanspruch und die Fähigkeit, Menschen und Kompetenzen gut einzuschätzen.
  
Deine Aufgaben
Du begleitest Recruitingprozesse von der ersten Anforderungsanalyse bis zum unterschriebenen Arbeitsvertrag und entwickelst gemeinsam mit People & Culture unsere Recruitingstandards weiter.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Führungskräften und der Geschäftsführung zusammen.
Talent Acquisition & Beratung
Du führst strukturierte Briefings mit Führungskräften und übersetzt Anforderungen in klare Kompetenz- und Kandidatenprofile.
Du berätst Führungskräfte bei der Auswahl geeigneter Kandidat:innen und sprichst auch dann eine klare Empfehlung aus, wenn die einfachste Lösung nicht die beste ist.
Interviews führst du eigenständig – vom operativen Recruiting bis hin zu Gesprächen auf Managementebene.
Kompetenzorientierte Auswahl
Wir wollen Auswahlentscheidungen stärker auf Kompetenzen und nachvollziehbare Kriterien stützen.
Du entwickelst strukturierte Interviewleitfäden, Bewertungsmatrizen und Auswahlstandards und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Entscheidungen vergleichbarer und belastbarer werden.
Bei diagnostischen Auswahlverfahren und Assessments begleitest du Konzeption, Durchführung und Auswertung.
Dein Anspruch dabei: weniger Bauchgefühl, mehr Qualität in der Entscheidung.
Candidate Experience & Kreativität
Professionelle Prozesse dürfen trotzdem persönlich sein.
Du entwickelst Ideen, wie wir Kandidat:innen besser erreichen und ihnen vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Einstellung eine überzeugende Candidate Experience bieten.
Dabei probierst du neue Recruitingwege aus, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns moderne Recruitingformate.
Vertragsmanagement & Prozesse
Du steuerst den Recruitingprozess zuverlässig bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
Du bereitest Vertragsangebote vor, koordinierst Abstimmungen und sorgst dafür, dass Vereinbarungen vollständig, korrekt und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
Arbeitsrechtliche und datenschutzrechtliche Fragestellungen erkennst du und kannst sie gemeinsam mit People & Culture bzw. unserer juristischen Expertise einordnen.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, standardisiert und detailgenau – ohne dabei unnötige Bürokratie aufzubauen.
 
Was du mitbringst
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftspsychologie, Psychologie, Personalmanagement, Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Erste praktische Erfahrung im Recruiting, Talent Acquisition, HR oder in der Personalauswahl ist hilfreich – beispielsweise durch Werkstudententätigkeiten, Praktika oder deine erste berufliche Station.
Auch wenn du am Anfang deiner Karriere stehst, freuen wir uns ausdrücklich auf deine Bewerbung.
Wichtiger als die Anzahl deiner Berufsjahre ist für uns, wie du denkst und arbeitest.
Du hast Interesse an eignungsdiagnostischen und kompetenzorientierten Auswahlverfahren.
Du kannst Gespräche strukturieren, genau zuhören, kritisch nachfragen und deine Einschätzung anschließend nachvollziehbar begründen.
Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und keine Scheu davor, mit Führungskräften und Geschäftsführung auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren.
Juristische Fragestellungen – insbesondere rund um Arbeitsverträge und Arbeitsrecht – schrecken dich nicht ab. Idealerweise bringst du bereits entsprechende Grundkenntnisse mit.
Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig und hast gleichzeitig Freude daran, Dinge neu zu denken.
 

Was uns bei dir besonders wichtig ist
Kreativität. 
Du akzeptierst nicht automatisch, dass Recruiting so funktionieren muss, wie es schon immer funktioniert hat.
Struktur. 
Du glaubst an Standards, klare Prozesse und nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen.
Detailorientierung.  
Ein falsches Datum im Arbeitsvertrag ist für dich keine Kleinigkeit.
Urteilsvermögen.
Du möchtest verstehen, welche Kompetenzen jemand wirklich mitbringt – und nicht nur, wie gut sich jemand präsentieren kann.
Mut zur Empfehlung.
Von dir erwarten wir nicht nur Organisation. Wir wollen deine Einschätzung hören.
Neugier.
Du möchtest verstehen, wie unser Geschäft funktioniert und was unsere Führungskräfte und Teams erfolgreich macht.
 

Was dich bei VielfaltMenü erwartet
VielfaltMenü steht für „Mehr als gutes Essen.“
Wir versorgen täglich Menschen in Bildungseinrichtungen und entwickeln uns als Unternehmen kontinuierlich weiter. People & Culture soll dabei nicht nur verwalten, sondern die Entwicklung des Unternehmens aktiv unterstützen. Du bekommst deshalb die Möglichkeit, unser Recruiting nicht nur auszuführen, sondern mitzugestalten. Du arbeitest eng mit Führungskräften, dem People & Culture-Team sowie der Geschäftsführung zusammen und erhältst früh Verantwortung für eigene Recruitingprozesse. Gleichzeitig geben wir dir Raum, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
In deiner Rolle genießt du echten Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust moderne Qualitäts- sowie Prozessstrukturen aktiv mit auf und prägst die Standards eines führenden Unternehmens für Kita- und Schulverpflegung in Deutschland. Dabei profitierst du von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer Geschäftsführung, die Qualität strategisch fördert.
Neben einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einem zukunftssicheren Markt erwarten dich eine attraktive, transparente Vergütung sowie klare Entwicklungsperspektiven durch strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungen. Wir unterstützen deine Work-Life-Balance durch 30 Urlaubstage, geregelte Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten. Zudem erhältst du moderne Arbeitsmittel inklusive Diensthandy. Eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und ein engagiertes, kollegiales Team runden unser Angebot ab.
 

Klingt nach dir?
Dann interessiert uns nicht nur dein Lebenslauf.
Wir möchten wissen, wie du über Menschen, Kompetenzen und gute Personalauswahl denkst.
Bewirb dich bei uns und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns, wie Recruiting bei VielfaltMenü künftig funktioniert.
 
VielfaltMenü – Mehr als gutes Essen.

  • Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.
  • Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.

  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

  • Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.
  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.

How We Win

Je groeit door van ondersteuner naar zelfstandig Servicecontract Coördinator van de gehele contractportefeuille.

Je leert onze organisatie, systemen, contractvormen en werkwijzen kennen. Je verzamelt, controleert en verwerkt contractgegevens en ondersteunt bij standaardcalculaties, offertes en wijzigingen.

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage IT
jobs.description:
Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou!

BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière.

Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten

1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering)
BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit.
Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure.

2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering)
In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk.
Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt.

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering)
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.
Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability.

4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management)
Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.
Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant.

5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product)
Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World.
Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse.

Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met zichtbare impact;

  • Dagelijkse begeleiding vanuit het team dat jouw opdracht host;

  • De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste IT-team;

  • Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS. Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: “Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!”;

  • Een vaste kruk bij de VrijMiBo en jouw naam op de gastenlijst voor onze bedrijfsuitjes en feestjes.


  • Je volgt een HBO-opleiding richting Software Engineering, DevOps, Data Science, AI, Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of een gerelateerde opleiding;

  • Je vindt het leuk om systemen en processen te verbeteren en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de drive om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Wij zijn BAS!

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen?

Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop.

jobs.title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Netherlands.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

    • Requirements

  • Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
  • Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
  • Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
  • Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
  • AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
  • Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
  • Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
  • Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
  • Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.
  • Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment.
  • Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms.

jobs.title: Talent Pool : Instructional Designer Learning Trajectories Care System
jobs.description:
Your mission

Overview 
  
War Child reaches many thousands of children and youth every year - yet there are 468 million children living with the effects of armed conflict. We will never reach them all by ourselves, which is why our strategic goal is to scale our impact by implementing evidence-based methodologies with partners. Together we can support the mental health and well-being of many more children affected by conflict.   
    
At the heart of our scaling strategy is War Child’s Care System approach.  The Care System includes   a range of evidence-based methodologies designed to improve the mental health and well-being of children and their caregivers.  These components can be selected based on partner needs, tailored for programme requirements and contextualized and integrated with existing services to build on local strengths.  
  
 Role
  
To make the adaptive Care System accessible to many more children and communities, we aim to collaborate with key stakeholders to co-design simple and effective learning pathways and resources to support all steps in the implementation process.   
   
As Learning Designer Care System, you will provide learning /instructional design expertise and collaborate with the core EBM teams to improve and build on existing learning paths and start new blended learning paths and learning resources. You will bring essential expertise in developing learning paths that are scalable and in line with our guiding principles. Where relevant you co-create and/or collaborate with our replication partners and local implementing partners to ensure the learning paths are contextualised and will be adopted by /co-owned by our replication partners.    You will also help to create learning materials and resources to strengthen partner’s abilities to implement evidence-based methodologies, including capacities such as coordination and quality assurance.  
Because this is a pool recruitment, selected candidates may be considered for current and future assignments depending on programme needs.
What you will do: 
Project ownership     

  • Take the lead in implementing learning design projects related to implementation of the Care System.
  • Align with technical leads and ensure input from practitioners, partners, finance and other key stakeholders    
Inclusive design     
  • Design and facilitate co-creation workshops to explore relevant creative questions and the needs and learnings of key stakeholders /partners.  
  • Ensure partners’ needs are centered in all learning paths and learning resources. Ensure the needs of partners are reflected in the final products
Learning Design and Development     
  • Provide instructional design, analysis and guidance for blended learning paths   
  • Ensure collaborative/inclusive design processes   
  • Plan, design and produce an e-learning course that is activity-based, learner-centered, interactive, including storyboard and able to develop (if relevant) animations, video, and/or illustrations.  
  • Produce or support the design of relevant accessible learning materials  
  • Publish prototypes related to the learning paths, resources and platforms  
 Adaptive learning   
  • Prepare and plan user testing once prototype is published  
  • Create an adaptive learning process to review the learning trajectories, gather recommendations for adjustments, assess and integrate   
  • Ensure lessons from Communities of Practice/ learning communities and implementers are gathered and assessed to enrich and improve learning paths and associated resources

To learn more about the role, please review the Job Description.


Your profile

Education

  • Education in Instructional Design, Digital Arts, or equivalent (using adult learning principles, methods, theories, and techniques) for global audiences.
Experience
  • Experience in designing scalable learning models.
  • Experience with e-learning authoring tools such as Evolve is a must.
  • A minimum of 5 years creating in-product micro learning and a portfolio showcasing your work.
Knowledge
  • Experience with a variety of tools, e-learning authoring tools and learning platforms, such as Evolve, WordPress, Canva, video editing tools, badging platform, and learning management systems (such as Kaya, which is Totara/Moodle based), and use of AI tools for learning design (including translation tools).
Skills
  • A passion for co-creating adaptive learning materials.
  • Strong facilitation skills to engage global, multi-disciplinary stakeholders.
  • An ability to ask the right creative questions to spark new solutions.
  • Someone who can build on existing strengths, systems and content.
  • Strong coordination skills.
Languages
  • Strong written and spoken English language skills.
  • Arabic/French/Arabic/Spanish would be an advantage. 
Other Requirements
  • Ability and willingness to travel to organize content sprints and experience field trainings.


What we offer

  • Location : This opportunity is open to candidates worldwide; professional proficiency in English is required. 
  • Type of Contract : Consultancy. 
Why You Should Apply
  • Meaningful Impact : Contribute directly to improving the lives of children and families affected by conflict through quality education and long-term, sustainable change.
  • Professional Growth: Join a dynamic organisation that values learning, innovation, and professional development, with opportunities for capacity building and growth through the role and War Child’s global network.
  • Global Reach : Play a key role in scaling a ground-breaking programme across multiple conflict-affected contexts worldwide.

jobs.title: Junior Market Data Analyst – Chartering
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.


Your future position

Join Kpler’s Chartering team as a Junior Market Data Analyst – Chartering and play a key role in ensuring the quality and accuracy of the data that powers our Chartering products.

Kpler’s Chartering products rely on accurate vessel, ownership and market data to help charterers, shipowners and brokers make informed commercial decisions. In this role, you will work hands-on with the datasets behind these products, investigating inconsistencies, validating information and helping improve data quality at scale.

Your work will span a range of chartering datasets, from vessel ownership and characteristics to fixtures, cargo orders, vessel positions and shipping zones. You will use SQL and Python to extract, transform and analyse data, build validation checks and investigate potential issues. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of data, asking why something doesn't look right and finding ways to identify and solve problems systematically. You will work closely with Product, Data, Research, Engineering and AI/ML teams, turning individual data issues into broader improvements across Kpler's datasets and products.


Your mission is to:
  • Monitor, validate and improve the quality of key datasets supporting Kpler's Chartering products.
  • Investigate data gaps, inconsistencies and customer-reported issues, using data analysis to understand their root causes and drive them through to resolution.
  • Curate and validate vessel ownership, commercial management, operator information and relevant vessel characteristics.
  • Review and benchmark AI-parsed fixtures, identifying recurring extraction errors and building validation approaches to measure and improve parsing quality.
  • Use SQL to query large datasets, including cargo and AIS data, to investigate potential issues and identify incorrect or inconsistent information at scale.
  • Use Python notebooks to extract, transform and analyse data and develop validation scripts and repeatable quality checks.
  • Maintain and improve Kpler's chartering-specific shipping zones and geographical mappings, using tools such as QGIS.
  • Work with Product, Data, Research, Engineering and AI/ML teams to provide structured feedback and help improve the quality of underlying datasets and extraction processes.
  • Translate individual data-quality issues into systematic improvements where appropriate, identifying patterns rather than only correcting individual records.
  • Contribute to the development of new analytical views and algorithms as the Chartering product evolves, including areas such as CPP/DPP and projected vessels.
  • Help establish and track data-quality metrics, benchmarks and processes as Chartering datasets expand.

    • Experience & Background:
  • 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, market research, maritime/shipping, commodities or a related analytical role.
  • Proven hands-on experience with SQL and confidence writing queries to analyse and investigate large datasets.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Python, including working in notebooks and using Python for data analysis, transformation or validation.
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and an ability to identify patterns and inconsistencies in data.
  • Comfortable working with large datasets and extracting and transforming data to investigate specific questions
    • Desirable:
  • Understanding of shipping, chartering or commodity markets.
  • Familiarity with tanker and/or dry-bulk vessel segments.
  • Understanding of concepts such as fixtures, vessel positions, cargo orders, vessel ownership and shipping geography.
  • Experience working with AI/LLM-extracted or other machine-generated datasets.
  • Experience with maritime data providers, brokers, shipowners, charterers or commodity trading companies.

    • You are naturally curious and want to understand why data is wrong, not just identify that it is wrong.
    • You are highly detail-oriented and take a methodical approach to investigating data issues.

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

About the Team

The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

Within Education, we partner with universities, schools, research institutions, and countrywide education systems to advance responsible, mission-aligned uses of AI. These environments require more than technical deployment: success depends on institutional trust, thoughtful governance, stakeholder education, change management, and a value narrative that resonates with academic leaders, researchers, IT teams, faculty, administrators, and students.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance.

As an Applied AI Architect for Education, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of education customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams.   • Help identify expansion opportunities where OpenAI can support additional academic, research, administrative, or operational workflows.

  • Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

About the Role

Maze customers need to reach the right participants and trust the quality of the people taking part in their studies. Recruitment is a critical part of research.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the recruitment and panel experience at Maze. You’ll help shape how customers recruit and manage participants across unmoderated, moderated, AI-moderated and future research experiences.

This is a highly cross-functional product area that sits at the intersection of product, operations and our panel partner ecosystem. You’ll work in a trio with Engineering and Design while partnering closely with our Panel Operations team, GTM, Customer Success, Research Partners and other product teams.

  • Define and measure success across participant quality, fulfillment and the overall recruitment experience.

  • You have strong product judgment and can make thoughtful tradeoffs when there isn’t a perfect answer.

  • You’re experienced partnering closely with Engineering and Design to take products from discovery through delivery and iteration.

  • You think in systems and look for scalable product solutions rather than one-off workarounds.

  • You’re comfortable balancing customer experience, business needs, operational realities and technical constraints.

  • You thrive in an environment where you can move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information and continuously learn from customers and internal teams.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Strong data fluency and experience using data to understand problems, prioritize opportunities and measure product outcomes.

  • Experience building products with a meaningful operational component.

  • Marketplace or supply-and-demand product experience.

  • Experience in operations, business development or other roles that required you to work across product and business problems.

  • Experience managing stakeholders across multiple teams or functions.

  • Experience working with external partners, vendors or integrations that are critical to the customer experience.

  • Experience with user research or research participant recruitment.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. jobs.title: Full time paid Internship DSU/ Stage DSU Paris
jobs.description:
Introduction

The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking.
The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations.
As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions.


About this job

The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations, sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks.
You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals.
No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered.
We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026. Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné).


Your profile

We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy.
Suitable candidates should have:

  • Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship.
  • Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code.
  • Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context.
  • Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction.
  • A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility.
  • An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking, particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy.
  • Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset.


Your responsibilities

Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will:

  • Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python.
  • Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources.
  • Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction.
  • Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences.
  • Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients.
  • Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes.


Our offer

We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications.
Many of our interns become full-time staff at Technopolis or go on to pursue opportunities in the public and private sectors.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules.

From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen. You will set and hold the release standard, define geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, manage engineering change orders, and act as the single authority signing off on product transfer gates to manufacturing.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance Analysis: Practical mastery of applying GD&T with intent, performing tolerance stack-up analyses, and defining clear acceptance criteria.

  • Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints.

  • Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows.

What We Offer

  • Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes.

  • Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage.

  • High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Characterization Lead
jobs.description:
At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Based primarily in Lausanne, you will work with silicon, signal integrity and validation teams, including channel characterization partners in Taiwan.

Responsabilities

· Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation.

· Characterize TX/RX SerDes performance across process, voltage and temperature: swing, jitter, sensitivity, equalization, adaptation, CDR lock, BER bathtubs and shmoos.

· Own channel measurements to at least 50 GHz, including de-embedding, insertion/return loss, mixed-mode S-parameters and common-mode and mode-conversion behavior.

· Establish reference-paddle baselines and channel classes by gauge, reach and frequency; correlate HTDR-derived metrics with calibrated VNA measurements.

· Derive datasheet limits and guard-bands from measured distributions, accounting for uncertainty, sample coverage and aging; maintain traceable datasets and limit revisions.

· Assess carrier-loading and forwarded-clock tradeoffs using measured channel data and simulation, and translate the findings into supported configurations and characterization limits.

· Characterize power, energy per bit and thermal behavior across operating modes and corners; investigate equalizer noise amplification and channel/thermal interactions.

· Coordinate shared laboratory equipment and characterization milestones with validation teams; lead technical reviews and deliver limits in time for downstream qualification and screening.

Essential Experience

· 10 to 14 years of experience in SerDes/silicon characterization and/or high-speed channel and signal integrity characterization following degree completion.

· Direct ownership of a characterization program whose results became datasheet limits or qualification thresholds for a shipping product.

· Strong VNA measurement experience to 50 GHz or beyond, including de-embedding, mixed-mode S-parameters (Sdd/Scc/Scd/Sdc) and insertion/return-loss mask interpretation.

· Hands-on TX/RX SerDes characterization, jitter decomposition, BER bathtubs, PVT shmoos and equalization/adaptation analysis.

· Demonstrated common-mode and mode-conversion measurement depth, with the ability to distinguish channel behavior from fixture and calibration artifacts.

· Statistical characterization and guard-band derivation across corners, with clear treatment of measurement uncertainty, sample size and aging.

· Experience with VNAs, oscilloscopes of at least 50 GHz bandwidth, BERTs, jitter instrumentation, thermal forcing and ATE characterization load boards.

· BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with the technical communication and coordination skills to hand off defensible limits to validation and manufacturing teams.

Essential Experience

· Characterization leadership for shipping 100G/lane or 200G/lane retimers, PHYs, AECs or AOCs.

· Deep mixed-mode characterization where common-mode behavior affects information transport and link margin.

· Experience producing datasheet limits that a separate validation team independently qualified.

· Multi-carrier or proprietary coding schemes, including OFDM-style subcarriers and space-time coding, and their characterization implications.

· Published work or patents in channel modeling, de-embedding or SerDes characterization.

· MS or PhD with a concentration in communications, RF/microwave engineering or signal integrity.

If this is the role you have been looking for and you want to be part of a growing Company, with an exciting future then we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!!

It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly driven, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

jobs.title: Communications Lead
jobs.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

Yubo doesn't have a PR team yet, and that's exactly why this role exists: to build one from scratch and help Yubo become culturally relevant, resilient to reputational bumps, and a real driver of growth.

It's a rare chance to shape a PR function from day one inside a fast-moving global tech company. You'll design how it works, lead our agency partner, and craft the stories, moments and relationships that make people pay attention to Yubo. The role covers everyday consumer stories, corporate communications, and handling sensitive issues or crises when they arise. To start, you'll focus on the US, UK and France, with room to grow from there.

You'll report to the Director of Brand & Communications and work closely with teams across the business, especially Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal. You'll own the relationship with our PR agency, making sure they feel like a true extension of the team, and you'll help set up the habits and processes that make PR part of how Yubo works day to day.

This is a freelance role on a 6-month contract, with a target start in Q4 2026.

Your responsibilites

Set up how PR works at Yubo

  • Build PR operations and onboard Yubo's PR agency, setting clear ways to spot stories, check facts, and turn insight into coverage.

  • Dig into Yubo's data to find trends and stories worth telling.

  • Build a simple way to report on PR performance, linking coverage and sentiment to awareness and growth.

  • Review and embed Yubo's Crisis Comms Playbook.

Plan and run the PR agenda

  • Build Yubo's 2027 PR calendar and strategy, balancing campaigns, cultural moments, and day-to-day press activity.

  • Lead proactive and reactive media relations so Yubo speaks with a clear, consistent voice.

  • Spot and activate cultural moments through PR, research, events, creator partnerships and other earned activity.

  • Team up with Product and Data to build proof points and stories that show what Yubo means to people.

Look after Yubo's reputation

  • Advise senior leaders on reputational opportunities and risks.

  • Support corporate communications and reactive issues management when needed.

  • Work with Trust & Safety and Legal so Yubo talks about sensitive topics responsibly.

  • Help rally the right people internally when a crisis hits.

Who you are

You're a proactive PR lead with sharp cultural instincts and a track record of creating stories that genuinely earn attention, not just promote launches.

You'll bring:

  • Solid PR experience, with real results to show from leading a function or campaign.

  • A good read on Gen-Z culture and how 18 to 24 year-olds socialise and engage online.

  • Experience turning insight and data into media stories, including digging into data yourself to find the angle.

  • A track record of using different levers to earn attention: influencers, experts, events, activations, research, stunts.

  • Experience managing and getting the best out of an external PR agency.

  • Good judgement under pressure, with experience in issues or crisis communications.

  • Strong writing and speaking skills, comfortable with both consumer storytelling and sensitive corporate messaging.

  • The ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.

  • A self-starter mindset, with examples of building something from the ground up.

Nice to have, but don't let that stop you:

  • Experience in high-growth tech, consumer apps, youth culture, media, entertainment or lifestyle.

  • Experience in the US market, including relationships with US media and journalists.

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, mission and community, and where our communications and reputation stand today.

  • Meet key people across Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal.

  • Start onboarding our PR agency and reviewing the Crisis Comms Playbook.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Have set up solid working habits with the PR agency and cross-functional teams.

  • Be well into building the 2027 PR strategy, calendar and measurement framework.

  • Have embedded the Crisis Comms Playbook and be actively building relationships with consumer, culture, lifestyle, tech and business media.

Within 6 months, you will

  • Have delivered Yubo's finished 2027 PR strategy and calendar.

  • Have landed our first standout data- and culture-led stories in top-tier media, backed by a working way to measure PR performance.

  • Have wrapped up the agency onboarding and defined the role of creators, experts, events and activations in Yubo's communications, leaving a solid foundation for what's next.

The recruitment process

  • A first introductory call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition

  • A case study with Alex, our Brand Director.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer (ML Systems) - Paris
jobs.description:
You’ll own the GPU compute that powers our model training, evaluation and serving systems.

This role sits in our Infrastructure team, which works at the lowest layers of our stack, from Kubernetes down to the GPU hardware. You’ll run the clusters, GPUs and schedulers that our research, product and platform teams depend on, and manage the capacity we buy from our cloud providers.

What success looks like

Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

What you’ll be doing

  • Running Kubernetes clusters for GPU training and inference

  • Improving how GPU work is scheduled and placed

  • Detecting, draining and repairing unhealthy GPU nodes

  • Managing capacity with our cloud providers

  • Debugging failures in GPUs, Linux, storage and networking

The first year

By month 3, you’ll be handling a share of cluster incidents on your own and will have shipped one change to scheduling or node health, such as automatically detecting and draining unhealthy GPU nodes. By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

Who you’ll work with

Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure team, the research and product teams who use our compute, and our cloud providers and other vendors.

What we think it takes

You’re likely a good fit if you:

  • Have built and run GPU workloads on Kubernetes

  • Could design a GPU cluster for training and online RL from scratch

  • Debug confidently at the OS layer and below (Linux, GPU drivers, networking and storage)

  • Write strong Python

It’s a plus if you’ve worked as an SRE or infrastructure engineer, or have used:

  • Slurm

  • Kubernetes scheduling and autoscaling tools such as Kueue or Karpenter

  • Multi-cloud orchestration tools such as SkyPilot

  • AWS services such as EKS or SageMaker HyperPod

  • High-performance interconnects and collective communication libraries such as EFA, InfiniBand, NCCL or Open MPI

  • Terraform

You don’t need ML research experience. If you match most of this but not every point, please apply.

How we hire

Four stages, about three hours in total: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute coding interview, a 60-minute system design interview and a closing 30-minute conversation with our VP of Engineering. The coding and system design interviews are modelled on real-world problems you’d face in this role.

Practicalities

The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office and occasional travel between the two. We offer a competitive package.

Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our Paris office, and a closing 30-minute conversation.

The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work.
